mission: Deliver one durable bootstrap program that runs on Drew's Android Termux phone and desktop environments, installs a locked-down local Fortress control plane, and remains useful after cloud-token exhaustion without using ChatGPT browser orchestration.

requestedOutcome.executionLane: machine-local user account; repository-backed Home Center runtime
exclusions: battery governor implementation in this slice
requestedOutcome.evidenceStandard: repository artifact plus deterministic self-test and review receipts; real phone/desktop deployment remains a separate runtime claim
requestedOutcome.deliverySurface: Valar05/home-center tools/fortress_bootstrap.py with a stable fortress command

facts: The current Adam installer and campaign scripts use Termux-specific shebangs.
The phone local-brain path uses llama-server on loopback port 8790.
The existing Vlad daemon supplies Android overlay and receipt integration when rish is callable.
Repository doctrine requires a durable campaign, protected active worktrees, resumability, backoff, status, receipts, and explicit capability-state separation.
Drew explicitly deferred battery charge-rate governance; only a disabled configuration placeholder may be retained.

selectedJudgmentJars.reason: Preserve one-script, phone-and-desktop, local-first, no-browser-orchestration boundaries.
Extend Home Center's actual Adam, llama.cpp, Vlad, and overlay bodies rather than inventing a detached demo.
Use a dedicated runtime clone and refuse destructive active-worktree replacement.
Require idempotent reruns, atomic queue claims, bounded retries, status, doctor, and receipts.
Install user-level persistence and prevent retry storms or duplicate workers.
Retain Android overlay/Vlad integration where the phone body actually exposes rish.
Forbid completion claims without deterministic checks, Regnet QA, and a separate Venice stop review.

plan: Implement one Python 3 standard-library file with install, sync, start, stop, restart, status, doctor, enqueue, run, ask, receipts, daemon, and contract-test commands.
Detect Termux, Windows, WSL, Linux, and macOS without requiring a second platform script.
Install into a protected per-user Fortress directory, create platform-native user-level persistence, and expose a stable fortress command.
Use a dedicated fast-forward-only Home Center runtime clone; never reset or overwrite Drew's active checkout.
Run a local filesystem queue with atomic claims, bounded retries, per-job receipts, and no network command listener.
Prefer existing loopback llama.cpp or Ollama for prompt jobs; keep deterministic command jobs callable when no model exists; never execute model output as commands.
On Termux, integrate the existing Vlad swarm daemon when rish and its repository body are available; absence degrades honestly instead of killing the control plane.
Record the battery governor as disabled and deferred, with no worker scaling based on battery in this slice.
Run the embedded contract test, inspect the exact diff, obtain Regnet QA, then obtain Venice completion permission before promotion.
antagonism: A shell-only bootstrap would silently exclude native Windows; use Python, which Drew's known phone and desktop both have.
Automatic model downloads can be large or impossible offline; model provisioning must be optional and failure must preserve deterministic execution.
A remote HTTP command server would expand attack surface; use an owner-local protected filesystem queue only.
An arbitrary-command queue is dangerous if writable by other users; protect directories and files and never accept unauthenticated network input.
Starting multiple daemons can duplicate side effects; use a PID/lock contract and atomic queue moves.
Blind git reset/pull can destroy work; only mutate the dedicated runtime clone and fast-forward or preserve current state.
Termux:Boot, systemd, launchd, and Task Scheduler can be absent or disabled; start immediately and report persistence state separately.
Repository and self-test evidence cannot prove either physical device is deployed; final reporting must keep implemented, tested, merged, installed, callable, and accepted distinct.
Battery tuning is tempting scope bait; preserve only the deferred hook requested by Drew.
reviewProvenance: Separate adversarial plan pass over repository evidence and the selected Judgment Jars.
